newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom Group seeks distributor stock listings.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom Group seeks distributor stock listings.

text.p: Auto-maker DRB-Hicom Group said on Monday that it is seeking to list eligible Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) distributors of Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd (EON) on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

The national Bernama news agency quoted the chairman of the Diversified Resources Bhd and Hicom Holdings Bhd group Yahaya Ahmad, who said the company initially hoped that at least five or six of the 150 Bumiputera distributors could merge to fulfill listing requirements.
"We have received government and Securities Commission (SC) consent to adopt this approach," he told reporters after the opening of a seminar.
EON distributes the national Proton car's Wira, Iswara and Perdana models.
"We have also discussed with all the Malay distributors of EON and Usahasama Proton DRB (USPD), who have agreed in principle (to this approach)," he said.

Recognising that not all the distributors could merge, Yahaya said in the case of USPD dealers, who distribute Proton's Satria and Tiara models, DRB-Hicom hoped at least 10 of the distributors' 40 biggest companies could be merged for listing.

He also said eligible EON and USPD distributors would be listed separately and this scheme would be subsequently extended to Bumiputera dealers of Motosikal dan Enjin Nasional Sdn Bhd (Modenas) retailing arm, Edaran Modenas Sdn Bhd (EMOS), which distributes the locally-made motorcycle.
Around 33 of EMOS' dealerships are Bumiputera.

The enlarged capital resulting from the mergers and listing would enhance the dealers' professional management and help them diversify into other areas like after-sales service and spare-parts and accessories, he added.

He did not give a timetable for when the listing on the exchange's small-capitalisation board might be achieved, but said it would depend on the SC and how technical hitches are sorted out, Bernama said.
